freeze_stage: BEFORE reading any app result or executing any production citation parser for this phase
source_description: Selected text and blocks from retained official API collection data/law-galaxy-sources.json. Most raw XML files were not available. No new official API comparison claimed.
purpose: Independent manually authored expectations for 24 newly selected source articles; not a legal opinion or a population accuracy estimate.

protocol.selection_method: Purposeful strata, not random sampling: four tax families; two source articles per family at each statute/decree/rule level. Article titles and body lengths inspected to balance deduction, taxation, filing and tax investigation. No app outputs, Storage documents, audit app details or production citation parser read/executed in this phase before annotation freeze.
protocol.helper_use: Exact substring location, lexical uncovered-token prompts for manual rereading, JSON serialization and hashes only; no automatic target inference.
protocol.independence: AI workflow blind against app output in this phase; same AI prior conversation had prior audit/parser exposure. Not a human double-blind study.

count_policy: A manual annotation is one source quote occurrence and may contain several targets.
Ranges remain one target scope; no endpoint-to-endpoint expansion or accuracy percentage is implied.
Own-article references, definition scopes within one article, and unspecified targets are separate context annotations.
One definition_scope annotation spans source article81 through83 and is separate from ordinary cross-article count.
Law-level, numbered article, annex/form and named-standard annotations have separate units.
Historical-target constraints and table item qualifiers must be retained during comparison.
limitations: Not a perfect human blind study: same AI conversation previously exposed to first-round audit and parser design. Previously audited 30 articles and four additional regression source articles excluded.
Title/length inspection and purposive functional selection introduce selection bias; not an unbiased random accuracy estimate.
Source is retained official-API collected text/blocks with MST and collection XML hash. Most original XML files not present here; no fresh API confirmation is claimed.
Expected citations will be manually authored from complete selected source bodies, not generated by any citation parser or app result.
Expected legal references are AI manually interpreted from source and may require independent human adjudication; none are guaranteed legal conclusions.
Current official law/body currency, actual target contents, applicability to a taxpayer, annex body interpretation and reverse completeness were not verified here.
Named generic delegations without a unique title/number have no inferred specific target.
All numbered and named references in the selected stored bodies were read, but this does not establish completeness or correctness for the whole corpus.

schema_notes.expected.ref: Natural Korean reference with 제; ranges use ~ and keep source quote. 표 제N호 denotes a numbered table row, not an ordinary provision item.
schema_notes.target_edition_constraint: When present the target is explicitly a historical edition. A current same-number row cannot alone satisfy edition correctness.
schema_notes.annex_subform: Parenthesized (1)/(2) suffixes and 의 branch numbers are intentionally preserved.
schema_notes.same_article: context_annotations retain explicit own-article references without counting them as cross-article links.
schema_notes.body_hash: SHA256 of the complete selected stored article.text UTF-8; no whitespace normalization.
schema_notes.official_match: retained-source-only is weaker than a newly retrieved official XML body comparison.
